title: Organization
description: Represents an organization in Workday. Organizations include supervisory organizations, cost centers, companies, regions, and other organizational types used to structure the enterprise.

id.description: The Workday ID of the organization.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the organization.

code.description: The organization reference ID or code.

organizationType.description: The type of organization (e.g., Supervisory, Cost Center, Company, Region).

superiorOrganization.description: The parent organization in the hierarchy.

location.description: The primary location of the organization.

staffingModel.description: The staffing model (e.g., Position Management, Job Management).

memberCount.description: The number of members in the organization.

includeInactiveSubOrganizations.description: Whether to include inactive subordinate organizations.

availabilityDate.description: The date the organization becomes available.

lastUpdated.description: The last time the organization was updated.

externalID.description: An external system identifier for the organization.

href.description: A link to the full organization resource.

ResourceReference.description: A reference to a Workday resource.

id.description: The Workday ID of the referenced resource.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the referenced resource.

href.description: A link to the referenced resource.
